11. Covelo  
12. Camping Iseo  

**Belvedere Clusane:** unranked conditional fallback until transient touring-pitch availability is confirmed directly.

**If you owned a SUP and wanted the nicest overall camping experience:**  
1. Covelo  
2. Punta d’Oro  
3. Camping Iseo

**If SUP rental reliability matters most:**  
1. Pilzone/Cave/Olivella + Lagovivo — dedicated rental, phone reservations welcomed, multiple boards evidenced; campsite access differs  
2. **Eurovil + Whassup Predore** — verified on-site rental plus a second dedicated rental operator in the same town  
3. Quai — on-site, published tariff, advance reservation explicitly recommended  
4. **Eden Pisogne + Surface/X Beach** — dedicated SUP specialist on the same lakeside strip with several board categories  
5. Riva di San Pietro + Surface — dedicated SUP specialist with several board categories  
6. Del Sole — on-site and convenient, but fleet count unpublished  
7. Sassabanek — on-site through Sporting Lido, operational through 6 Sep for this trip  
8. Punta d’Oro — on-site but only two boards

**If price matters most on 2 September:**  
1. **Olivella Zone A (~€37 for two adults incl. tourist tax)** — cheapest published direct-lake option, subject to camper-access fit  
2. Sassabanek if staying 5+ nights and using the September offer  
3. Del Sole / Quai (already in shoulder-season bands)  
4. Eden (current directory comparison roughly mid-to-high €40s for a couple; confirm exact quote)  
5. Pilzone / Cave  
6. Covelo if you already have a valid ACSI card and accept fourth row  
7. Eurovil — cannot be fairly placed on price until a touring-pitch quote is obtained

**If you have a large motorhome:**  
1. Del Sole — book one of the large 7–9 m-capable pitches  
2. Punta d’Oro — specifically ask for one of the XXL-capable pitches  
3. Covelo — confirm exact pitch dimensions before booking  
Avoid building your route around the old Riva di Solto–Lovere waterfront road.

---

# ACSI: what the discount actually means

CampingCard ACSI can be used in **digital or physical** form; present a valid card at check-in.

The generic 2026 ACSI rate includes two adults, a camper with awning, electricity up to 6A/4 kWh per day, showers and a standard or qualifying “luxury” pitch. But **each campsite controls its acceptance dates and may exclude premium categories**. That is exactly what matters here:

- **Covelo:** the published 2026 ACSI rate starts **1 September**, but the price sheet limits it to **fourth-row pitches**; lakefront/second/third row are excluded.
- **Sassabanek:** ACSI starts **6 September**, so it does not help on your 2 September arrival. Use the separate September promotion instead.

Do not buy an ACSI card solely on the assumption that it discounts a first-row lakefront pitch.

---

# Booking questions worth asking every campsite

Before paying a deposit, ask for:

1. **Exact pitch number and dimensions**, not just category.
2. Whether the pitch is **first-row lakefront or merely “lake zone/view.”**
3. Whether you can **carry/launch your own SUP directly from the campsite** and where it may be stored.
4. If renting, whether **two SUPs can be reserved for the same time slot**. This is especially important at Punta d’Oro (only two boards); Quai explicitly recommends booking equipment one day ahead; Lagovivo welcomes phone reservations.
5. **Electricity amperage** (4A vs 6A matters with camper appliances).
6. Your rental camper’s exact **length, width and height** and whether the chosen pitch/arrival route accepts all three. Width/height matter on Lake Iseo roads, not just length.
7. Whether the quoted rate includes **people, electricity, car, booking fee and tourist tax**.

---

# Useful websites, directories, booking tools and forums

For campsite facts and prices, **prefer the campsite's own website**. Use the directories and forums mainly for reviews, comparison, availability checks and practical camper experience.

## Best general planning resources

| Resource | What it is useful for | Link |
|---|---|---|
| **Visit Lake Iseo** | Official tourism portal; campsites, SUP operators, attractions, events and local practical information | https://visitlakeiseo.info/ |
| **Navigazione Lago d’Iseo** | Official ferries: Monte Isola routes, timetables, fares and notices. Particularly useful because ferry traffic matters when paddling across the lake | https://navigazionelagoiseo.it/en/ |
| **Camping.info — Lake Iseo** | Broad campsite directory with camper reviews and rating breakdowns; currently lists about 15 sites around the lake | https://www.camping.info/en/popular-region/lake-iseo |
| **PiNCAMP / ADAC — Iseo** | ADAC campsite profiles, ratings, pitch counts and filters; useful as a second opinion on facilities | https://www.pincamp.com/italy/lombardy/iseo |
| **CampingCard ACSI — Lake Iseo** | Low-season discounts and inspector notes. Covelo's 2026 acceptance starts 1 Sep (fourth-row only); Sassabanek starts 6 Sep. Physical **or digital** valid card can be presented/scanned | https://www.campingcard.co.uk/italy/lake-iseo/ |
| **Pitchup — Iseo** | Useful for live-ish bookable inventory, prices and reviews where a campsite participates; coverage is incomplete | https://www.pitchup.com/campsites/italy/lombardia/brescia/iseo/ |
| **CamperOnLine stopovers around Lake Iseo** | Motorhome stopovers, camper areas and services around the lake | https://www.camperonline.com/en/motorhome-stopovers/camper-stop/lago-d-iseo/985 |
| **Campercontact** | Strong European motorhome community database with recent reviews and practical facilities information | https://www.campercontact.com/ |
